Metadata.title: CivicEye
Metadata.description: Report, track and resolve civic infrastructure issues.

Home.heading: Report civic problems to the people responsible for fixing them
Home.intro: CivicEye will let residents report issues such as potholes, broken streetlights, drainage problems and garbage accumulation, and follow each report until the work is verified.
Home.developmentNotice: CivicEye is not yet open for reports. Submitting and tracking reports will be available in a future release.
Home.emergencyNotice: CivicEye is not an emergency service. For dangerous situations, contact your local emergency services.

ReportForm.title: Report an issue
ReportForm.emergency: CivicEye is not an emergency service. If anyone is in danger, contact local emergency services first.
ReportForm.titleHint: 5–120 characters, e.g. “Deep pothole near the bus stop”.
ReportForm.descriptionHint: 10–2,000 characters. What is wrong and how serious is it?
ReportForm.photosHint: 1 to 5 photos, JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each. Location and camera details are removed from photos.
ReportForm.photoWrongType: {name} is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
ReportForm.photoLimit: You can add at most 5 photos.
ReportForm.photoFailed: Upload failed. Remove it and try again.
ReportForm.locationHint: Tap the map to place the pin where the problem is, then drag it to adjust.
ReportForm.locationDenied: Location access was not allowed. Place the pin on the map instead.
ReportForm.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be found. Place the pin on the map instead.
ReportForm.locationRequired: Place the pin on the map.
ReportForm.coordinatesHint: Or enter coordinates. Only locations in Bangladesh are accepted.

ReportForm.locationDescriptionHint: Landmarks that help find it, e.g. “opposite Banani Road 11 bridge”.
